spans.s:
शिपिः A ray of light. --f. Skin,
leather. --n. Water;
शैत्याच्छयनयागोच्च शिपि वारि प्रचक्षते Vyāsa.
--Comp.
[]
--विष्ट a. (written शिपविपष्ट or शिविपष्ट
also) {1} pervaded by rays. {2} bald,
bald-headed. {3} leprous.
--(ष्टः) {1}
an epithet of Viṣṇu. {2} of Śiva.
{3} a bald man. {4} a man without
prepuce. {5} a leper.

शिप्रः N. of a lake on the
Himālaya.
--प्रं

A cheek; jaw.
--2
The chin.
--3 The nose.
--4 A
helmet or visor.

1 N. of a river which issues
from the Sipra lake and on the bank
of which stands Ujjayinī;
शिप्रावातः प्रियतम इव प्रार्थनाच टुकारः

1 A woman's zone or
girdle.
--2 A female buffalo.
--3 A
river near Ujjayinī; see शिप्रा.

सीपः A sacrificial vessel in the
shape of a boat.
